user.title: Egg Delivery Tracker
user.description: Set your recurring delivery schedule and automatic confirmation.

additional.title: Add an extra delivery
additional.description: Adds a delivery without changing your regular fortnightly schedule.

replacement.title: Replace a regular delivery
replacement.description: Choose the original delivery, then its replacement date. Reset cycle starts the regular interval again from the replacement date.

data.reset_cycle: Reset fortnightly cycle from the new date

remove_special.title: Remove a planned special delivery
remove_special.description: Removing a replacement restores the original regular delivery.

error.invalid_replacement: Cannot replace that delivery. Check it has not already been delivered or replaced.
error.invalid_special: That special delivery is no longer available.

abort.no_regular_deliveries: No upcoming regular deliveries are available to replace.
abort.no_special_deliveries: There are no pending special deliveries to remove.
